plot_benchmark_fps_bar_chart: plot a horizontal bar chart of FPS benchmark results from profile data files and save as PDF
parse_fps_from_profile_files: parse FPS values from benchmark profile text files in data/profile directory
calculate_mean_and_std: calculate mean FPS and standard error of the mean across multiple benchmark runs
generate_latex_table_output: print benchmark results in LaTeX table format with mean and standard error values
save_benchmark_plot_as_pdf: save the benchmark comparison bar chart as a PDF file in the data/profile directory
